concept: A pane that rises over a dimmed scene at level 3 of the stack and holds the reader until they answer, the overlay step of the light model.

default_to_avoid.pattern: a centred white modal box on a black 50% backdrop (Bootstrap modal, Material dialog)
default_to_avoid.why_not: a flat white box on black ignores the stack: it has no level, no glass and no light

derivation.consequence: light falls from above, so every surface carries a rim brightest along its top edge and a soft shadow below that says where it floats, and a recess is the inverse, shaded under its top lip and lit on its bottom lip; a nested surface adds no second blur, because one sheet of glass is one layer
derivation.form: the dialog is level 3: its own body and longer shadow, above the scrim, and the scrim dims the scene under it

derivation.consequence: panes enter by rising a short distance and settling, as an object placed in space would
derivation.form: it rises a short way and settles as it opens, the scrim fades

derivation.consequence: keyboard reaches everything a pointer can, with a visible focus ring on any backdrop
derivation.form: focus moves into it, stays in it and returns to the trigger; Esc closes it

options: A level-3 pane over a scrim
variants.picked: A level-3 pane over a scrim
variants.reason: A uses the measured levels (D-025): a scrim and a lighter pane that rises. B hides the context the question is about. C does not hold focus and is not a dialog.

scrim.why: the scrim dims and softens the scene so the dialog reads as above it

dialog.why: a level-3 pane centred in the viewport, one measure wide, scrolling inside itself

lg.why: a wider dialog for a short form, still with a margin to the screen edge

title.why: the title in the title size, the accessible name of the dialog

description.why: one or two sentences in secondary text, the accessible description

body.why: the content between the description and the actions, on the overlay gap

actions.why: actions at the foot, the loud one last at the end, apart from the others

preview.why: drawn in place for documentation: open, not modal, without the scrim, never in a product flow

focus-visible.why: the shared focus ring on the pane or control so a keyboard user sees where they are

@media forced-colors: active.why: forced colours draw an outline so the overlay keeps its edge without the glass

@fade.why: the scrim fades in at entry pace, zero under reduced motion

@rise.why: the dialog rises a short way and settles, zero under reduced motion
